payload.reason: The evidence indicates that zero-shot transfer from RXR to R2R is possible and has been demonstrated with improved performance metrics.

claims.text: Zero-shot transfer from RXR to R2R can be performed, showing improved performance metrics.
The CLEAR approach outperforms the baseline in zero-shot performance on the R2R dataset by 4.5% in success rate and 2.2% in SPL.
The CLEAR method demonstrates better generalizability when transferred from RXR to R2R.
